# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{index}/files

Get changed files for a pull request

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-233`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | int64 | True |
| skip-to | query | string | False |
| whitespace | query | string | False |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## Response

**200** — ChangedFileList

- **404** — PR not found

| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | gitdiff.GetDiffForAPI | service | Run git diff between start and end commits; Parse diff output into DiffFile structs |

| 5 | [services](../modules/services.md) | convert.ToChangedFile | utility | Convert diff file to API format with URLs |

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| high | unbounded_queries | GetDiffForAPI loads ALL files (MaxFiles=-1) into memory before pagination is applied | Implement server-side file pagination in git diff |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P1] pagination**: Limit files loaded from git diff to the requested page instead of loading all — *Impact: Significant memory reduction for large PRs*
